concerns.text: FR-004 requires logging the exact count of permutations executed for every query. Task T013a logs this to `permutation_state.json`, but Task T016 (p-value calculation) is marked `[ ]` (unimplemented) and depends on T013a. Without T016, the logged counts are never consumed to calculate p-values, leaving FR-004's requirement to 'calculate a permutation p-value' unfulfilled by any task.

FR-002 and FR-003 require generating null distributions and computing scores. Task T017 (Save null distribution CSVs) is marked `[ ]` (unimplemented). No other task produces the null distribution artifacts required by FR-003 and US-1 acceptance scenario 2.

FR-008 requires findings to be framed as statistical association. Task T027 (Add explicit text generation) is marked `[ ]` (unimplemented). No other task produces the `analysis_framing.txt` artifact or the required text output, leaving FR-008 unfulfilled.

US-3 (Reporting & Visualization) requires generating PNG density plots and a CSV summary. Tasks T029 (Generate density plots), T030 (Annotate plots), and T031 (Generate summary CSV) are all marked `[ ]` (unimplemented). No tasks exist to fulfill the deliverables in US-3.

FR-007 requires sensitivity analysis (alpha sweep). Task T024 (Implement sensitivity analysis) is marked `[X]` (complete) in the text description but the task list item `T024` is missing from the implementation list under Phase 4, while `T024.1` (Verification) exists. The implementation task T024 appears to be missing or mislabeled, leaving the generation of `alpha_sweep.csv` unassigned.

FR-001 requires downloading TREC Robust 2004 and Web Track 2009-2012. Tasks T004.1 through T004.5 cover Robust 2004 and Web 2009-2012 individually. However, there is no task explicitly aggregating or validating the *entire* set as a group, and T006 (validation logic) is marked `[X]` but the Analyze report flags it as rejected/missing schema. If T006 is not functional, the validation requirement for the full dataset set is unfulfilled.

FR-009 and FR-010 require runtime/memory limits. Task T045 (Final end-to-end test) is marked `[ ]` (unimplemented). Without T045, there is no task to verify the pipeline executes within the 6-hour/7GB limits, leaving the success criteria unverified.

Task T024 is listed in the 'Implementation for User Story 2' section description but is missing from the actual task list items (only T024.1 exists). This creates a gap where the implementation of the alpha sweep is not explicitly assigned a task ID in the checklist, potentially causing the feature to be skipped.
